_notes: Single source of truth for what the DualSense sidecar may ship. Consumed by the
build (payload selection), packaging (ZIP audit) and review (human sign-off).
denied wins over groups, so a later rule can never re-admit a forbidden tool.
Payload policy stages: legacy-v1 (shipped 1.4.2/1.4.3, fails this policy) and composite-only-v1
(this file: no tooling, no runtime signing, HID-only runs over USB/IP). audited-hid-v1 is reserved
for a future prebuilt signed package; this repository has no provider for it, so it cannot be built.
Changing this file is the authorisation change; it must be reviewed in a PR.

denied.reason: SDK signing tool chain: no redistribution basis for this driver-deployment use, and the runtime must not sign drivers
WDK catalog tooling: no public redistribution grant found for this use; catalogs are produced at release time
usbip-win2 installers are unreachable after managed-usbip.patch; the Control Panel downloads them from upstream instead
the component only publishes win-x64-self-contained, so arm64 payload can never be reached
no Sunshine code path references the SteamVR payload
symbols are not part of the reviewed payload

groups.reason: bundled controller profiles; only dualsense and dualsense-composite are consumed
UMDF driver package kept for a future prebuilt signed stage; the shipped composite-only stage never deploys it
prebuilt catalog; required once runtime signing is removed
reference copy used only to validate the externally managed transport, never deployed
embedded copy of the component compatibility contract
patched managed Core; its embedded resources are audited separately
runtime pack or NuGet dependency; replace this catch-all with an exact file manifest in M1
localized strings and schema resources embedded in runtime assemblies; pinned by the runtime manifest in M1
runtime metadata; pin an exact file manifest in M1
